notes.title: Knock Harder. Release!
notes.notes:
Today, the full version of the game Knock Harder was released on Steam. More than 200 basic and additional dream signs, secret endings, 3 types of enemies, 3 types of weapons, and more

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1216490/Knock_Harder/

-Added 5 new dream signs (3 of which are references)
-Added a new achievements, not associated with dream signs
-Some minor details

-Added to the credits: Garder =RGBD=, SHOkir (but the dream signs themselves will only be in the paid version. They didn't look good in easy level)
The main character, the people from the photos and the picture now have eyes.

- First aid kit in the arena appears a little more often
- Fixed an error with a male name in the girl's documents (English version only)
- Fixed the sprites of the dice (opposite faces should give 7 in total. Did you know:)? )
-Now you can switch to window mode via alt-Enter and change the window size
"A few little things.

Achievements:
-A new Achievement on death still in prologue (that it comes not so it's a shame was :) )
-New Achievements on 2 basic and 1 an additional a sign of sleep, which me seem interesting (but now need to their precisely pass, not to visit as before)

Generation:
- Additional signs of sleep fall out more often
- The probability of sleep sign "399" more
- Sort of fixed a bug with the white screen hanging (if it happens again, tell me)

- Remade the movement of enemies. Again, if they still fly to the right in the bedroom, let us know

-Any trifle.

Various minor edits that almost no one will notice. 

What I write: if someone will have zombies in the bedroom and fly into the wall after the update-let me know)
